thegoodgarden.bio: Pacific Northwest vegetable gardening, zone 8b. Raised beds, cover crops, and what to sow this month.

everafterplans.name: Ever After Plans
everafterplans.bio: Wedding planning without the panic. Timelines, budgets, the seating chart spreadsheet everyone asks for.

purlandpine.name: Purl & Pine
purlandpine.bio: Knitting patterns, mostly free. Cables, colourwork, and socks that fit. Yarn weights in every pattern.

smallspacebig.name: Small Space, Big Life
smallspacebig.bio: Living well in 480 square feet. Storage, fold-away furniture, and the one rule: everything has a home.

alicechen.name: Alice Chen
alicechen.bio: Boards: bike shed ideas, cabin someday, things to cook after a ride.

bmartinez.name: Bob Martinez
bmartinez.bio: Bread. Only bread. Occasionally a shelf to put the bread on.

carolnk.name: Carol Nakamura
carolnk.bio: Deck refresh, dog-proof garden, kid-proof everything else.

p-5101.author: nestandnook
p-5101.image: Entryway with a thrifted oak bench, three brass hooks and a woven basket
p-5101.text: Entryway on a $90 budget. The bench was $40 at the ReStore, sanded and oiled. Hooks are brass, $12 for three. Basket holds every shoe the household owns and one it does not. Full before-and-after on the board.

p-5102.author: butterandthyme
p-5102.image: Skillet of crispy gnocchi with cherry tomatoes, burst and glossy, basil on top
p-5102.text: One-pan crispy gnocchi with burst tomatoes. 25 minutes. Shelf-stable gnocchi goes straight into the hot pan, no boiling, and it gets crunchy edges. Cherry tomatoes, garlic, a knob of butter, basil at the end. Serves 2 generously.

p-5103.author: sawdustsundays
p-5103.image: A simple three-shelf pine bookcase with dado joints, unfinished, on a garage bench
p-5103.text: Beginner bookcase with dadoes: one 1x10 board, a hand saw, a chisel and a Saturday. Plan with cut list on the board. Mistake I made this time: measured the shelves before the sides. Do not do that.

p-5104.author: thegoodgarden
p-5104.image: Raised bed of garlic cloves being pressed into dark soil, a hand trowel to the side
p-5104.text: Plant garlic NOW (zone 8b): September to mid October. Hardneck for the scapes, softneck for storage. Cloves pointy side up, 2 inches deep, 6 inches apart, mulch with straw. Harvest in July. That is the whole method.

p-5105.author: everafterplans
p-5105.image: A colour-coded wedding day timeline printed on cream paper, coffee mug beside it
p-5105.text: The wedding day timeline template everyone messages me for. Ceremony at 4? Hair starts at 10, photos at 2, first look at 2:30. Buffer everything by 15 minutes. Free download on the board.

p-5106.author: purlandpine
p-5106.image: A pair of grey cabled wool socks on a wooden floor beside a mug
p-5106.text: Free pattern: The Ferry Socks. Fingering weight, 2.25mm needles, an easy 4-stitch cable that keeps you awake on the commute. Sizes S to XL, heel flap or short row, your call.

p-5107.author: smallspacebig
p-5107.image: A murphy bed folded up into a white wall unit with a fold-down desk in front
p-5107.text: 480 square feet, one wall: bed by night, desk by day. The unit is a flat-pack, the desk folds with the laptop still on it (tested, nervously). Everything has a home. This is the home for the bed.

p-5108.author: nestandnook
p-5108.image: A dark green painted bedroom wall with warm brass sconces and white linen bedding
p-5108.text: Painted one wall dark green and the whole room grew up. Colour is a mid-tone forest, eggshell finish. Sconces are plug-in, no electrician. Total: one gallon and an afternoon.

p-5109.author: butterandthyme
p-5109.image: Sheet pan of roasted chicken thighs with lemon halves, potatoes and green olives
p-5109.text: Sheet pan lemon chicken with potatoes and olives. 40 minutes, 10 of them hands-on. Thighs skin up, potatoes cut small so they finish together, olives in for the last 10. Sunday dinner, Monday lunch.

p-5110.author: thegoodgarden
p-5110.image: A raised bed sown with crimson clover, seedlings just up in neat rows
p-5110.text: Cover crops for empty beds: crimson clover for nitrogen, winter rye for structure. Sow in September, chop and drop in March. Your soil will thank you in June. Seed rates on the board.

p-5111.author: sawdustsundays
p-5111.image: A hand plane taking a long curling shaving off a maple board
p-5111.text: Sharpening changed everything. Not the plane, not the wood, the edge. 1000 then 8000 waterstone, strop, done, six minutes. Full sharpening board pinned for anyone starting out.

p-5112.author: alicechen
p-5112.image: A small timber bike shed with a green roof and a sliding barn door
p-5112.text: Bike shed goals. Green roof, sliding door, room for three bikes and the one I have not bought yet. Saving this for the spring.

p-5113.author: everafterplans
p-5113.image: A seating chart spreadsheet with colour-coded tables projected on a kitchen wall
p-5113.text: The seating chart spreadsheet. Tables across the top, guests down the side, a column for who cannot sit near whom. It has saved eleven friendships. Free on the board, bring your own drama.

p-5114.author: smallspacebig
p-5114.image: A narrow hallway with a floor-to-ceiling shallow shelving wall holding shoes, books and baskets
p-5114.text: Shallow shelves are the small-space cheat code. 8 inches deep, floor to ceiling, in a hallway that was doing nothing. Shoes, books, the basket of cables everyone has. Nothing on the floor.

p-5115.author: purlandpine
p-5115.image: A cream and rust colourwork hat in progress on circular needles
p-5115.text: Colourwork for the nervous: two colours, a 6-row repeat, no floats longer than 5 stitches. The Harbour Hat, free pattern, worsted weight. If you can knit and purl you can do this.

p-5116.author: bmartinez
p-5116.image: A sourdough loaf with a wheat-pattern score, deep golden crust, on a rack
p-5116.text: Scoring pattern I am finally getting right after a year. Wheat ear, shallow angle, one confident stroke. Saving so I remember which blade.

p-5117.author: butterandthyme
p-5117.image: A bowl of miso butter noodles with a soft egg and scallions
p-5117.text: Miso butter noodles, 15 minutes, one pot. Butter, white miso, a splash of the pasta water, that is the sauce. Soft egg on top if you have one. This is the recipe for the night you do not want a recipe.

p-5118.author: nestandnook
p-5118.image: A rented kitchen with peel-and-stick tile backsplash in white herringbone
p-5118.text: Renter-friendly backsplash: peel-and-stick herringbone, $60 for the whole wall, came off clean when we moved. The landlord asked where we bought it.

p-5119.author: carolnk
p-5119.image: A cedar deck with built-in bench seating and a low fence gate
p-5119.text: Deck refresh idea: built-in bench along one side, low gate so the dog stays in and the kids stay out of the garden. Pinning before Jonah gives me a quote.

p-5120.author: thegoodgarden
p-5120.image: Rows of kale, chard and leeks under a low hoop tunnel in a raised bed
p-5120.text: What to sow in September for winter: kale, chard, leeks (transplants), spinach, mache, and a last round of radishes. Hoop tunnel goes on in November. Zone 8b, adjust for yours.

p-5121.author: sawdustsundays
p-5121.image: A walnut cutting board with a juice groove and a routed handle, oiled and glossy
p-5121.text: End-grain walnut board, first try. Glue-up went sideways, literally, and the clamps fixed it. Juice groove with a router, handle with a cove bit. Plan and glue-up order on the board.

p-5122.author: everafterplans
p-5122.image: A wedding budget spreadsheet with categories and a pie chart of actual spend
p-5122.text: Where the money actually goes: venue and food 45%, photography 12%, flowers 8%, the rest is a hundred small things. The budget template tracks all of them. Free on the board.

p-5123.author: smallspacebig
p-5123.image: A folding dining table against a wall with two stools hung on hooks above it
p-5123.text: Dinner for four in a studio: wall-mounted drop-leaf table, stools on hooks when not in use. Takes eleven seconds to set up. I timed it. Everything has a home.

p-5124.author: purlandpine
p-5124.image: A stack of five knitted dishcloths in cotton, each a different stitch pattern
p-5124.text: Five dishcloths, five stitch patterns, one weekend. Cotton worsted, 4.5mm needles. The best way to learn a new stitch is to make something you will use badly.

p-5125.author: alicechen
p-5125.image: A one-pan gnocchi dish in a cast iron skillet on a camp stove
p-5125.text: The Butter & Thyme gnocchi thing works on a camp stove. Made it after the Iron Horse ride. Saving for the next one.

p-5126.author: nestandnook
p-5126.image: A living room before-and-after split: beige and bare, then layered rugs, plants and a gallery wall
p-5126.text: Sunday before-and-after: same room, same furniture, $210. Layered rugs, a gallery wall of thrifted frames, four plants. Moving things is free. Start there.
